title: PUCCH format 0
text: PUCCH format 0 carries up to 2 bits of Uplink Control Information. The PUCCH format 0 sequence is generated based on a base sequence and a cyclic shift derived from the slot number and the symbol index. A UE shall transmit PUCCH format 0 using a single OFDM symbol when configured by higher layers. Higher layers may also indicate that the UE shall transmit PUCCH format 0 spanning two OFDM symbols.

title: PUCCH format 3
text: PUCCH format 3 supports payloads larger than 2 bits and can span between 4 and 14 OFDM symbols. The DFT-s-OFDM waveform is used. Encoded UCI bits are modulated using QPSK or pi/2-BPSK as configured. Demodulation reference signals occupy one or two OFDM symbols according to the configured hop pattern.

title: PUSCH demodulation reference signals
text: Demodulation reference signals for PUSCH are mapped to resource elements according to the configured DMRS configuration type. The reference signal sequence is generated from a length-31 Gold sequence initialized by the scrambling identity provided by higher layers. The receiver uses these reference signals to estimate the uplink channel before decoding the PUSCH payload.

title: UE transmit power for PUSCH
text: The UE transmit power for PUSCH in a transmission occasion is determined by the open-loop component, the closed-loop component, and the path loss compensation factor. The path loss is estimated from a configured downlink reference signal. The closed-loop component is updated by accumulated TPC commands received in DCI.

title: PUCCH resource selection
text: When a UE has HARQ-ACK feedback to transmit and no other PUCCH resource is configured, it selects a PUCCH resource from a configured resource set. The resource set index is determined by the size of the UCI payload. Within a resource set the specific PUCCH resource is indicated by an implicit mapping from the first CCE of the corresponding DCI.

title: RRC reconfiguration with sync
text: The RRCReconfiguration message including reconfigurationWithSync triggers the UE to perform a synchronous reconfiguration to a target cell. The UE applies the new configuration, performs random access on the indicated target serving cell, and resets MAC. Upon successful completion the UE sends an RRCReconfigurationComplete message on the new cell.

title: RRCSetup message
text: The RRCSetup message is sent by the network in response to an RRCSetupRequest. It carries the initial radio bearer and physical layer configuration for the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state. The UE applies the configuration, establishes SRB1, and replies with RRCSetupComplete.

title: Measurement report triggering
text: A UE evaluates configured measurement events at each measurement period. When the entering condition of an event has been fulfilled for the configured time-to-trigger, the UE triggers the corresponding measurement report. The report carries the cell identity, RSRP, RSRQ and where configured SINR for the serving cell and a set of neighbour cells.

title: Uplink grant reception
text: The MAC entity receives an Uplink grant either via PDCCH addressed to the C-RNTI or via a configured grant. Upon receiving an Uplink grant the MAC entity selects a logical channel for transmission according to the logical channel prioritization procedure and instructs the multiplexing and assembly entity to build the corresponding transport block.

title: Buffer Status Report triggers
text: A Buffer Status Report shall be triggered when uplink data arrives in the buffer of a logical channel belonging to an LCG and either no data was previously available for any logical channel in the LCG or the data that arrived belongs to a logical channel with higher priority than the logical channels for which data was already available. A regular BSR is also triggered when the retxBSR-Timer expires and there is data available for transmission.

title: NR radio protocol architecture
text: The NR radio protocol architecture is organized into the RRC, SDAP, PDCP, RLC and MAC sublayers in the control and user planes. The SDAP sublayer maps QoS flows to data radio bearers. The PDCP sublayer provides ciphering, integrity protection and header compression. RLC operates in three modes: AM, UM and TM. MAC handles HARQ, multiplexing and logical channel prioritization.

title: SCell activation and deactivation
text: In carrier aggregation the network can add Secondary Cells to a UE configured with a Primary Cell. SCells are added in deactivated state. The network activates an SCell using a MAC Control Element. After activation the UE applies the configuration for the SCell and may transmit and receive on it. An SCell is deactivated either by another MAC CE or when the sCellDeactivationTimer expires.

title: Downlink resource grid
text: The downlink transmitted signal in each slot is described by one or several resource grids of subcarriers and OFDM symbols. The resource grid for an antenna port is composed of resource elements. Each resource element corresponds to one subcarrier in the frequency domain and one OFDM symbol in the time domain. The number of resource blocks depends on the downlink transmission bandwidth configured in the cell.

title: PUCCH format 1 sequence
text: For LTE PUCCH format 1, the sequence is obtained by applying a cyclic shift to a base sequence and spreading by a block-wise orthogonal cover code across the SC-FDMA symbols within a slot. The base sequence depends on the physical cell identity. PUCCH format 1 carries a scheduling request indication only.

title: RRC connection reconfiguration
text: The RRCConnectionReconfiguration procedure modifies an established RRC connection. The procedure is used to establish, modify or release radio bearers, to perform handover, to setup, modify or release measurements, and to add, modify or release secondary cells. When mobilityControlInfo is included the UE performs a handover to the target cell indicated.

title: Radio link failure detection
text: A UE in RRC_CONNECTED considers a radio link failure to have occurred when the timer T310 expires, a random access procedure fails on the SpCell, or RLC retransmits a PDCP PDU the maximum number of times. Upon RLF detection the UE triggers connection re-establishment and selects a suitable cell.

title: Discontinuous Reception
text: The MAC entity may be configured with a DRX functionality that controls the UE's PDCCH monitoring activity in RRC_CONNECTED. The DRX cycle defines the periodic repetition of an on-duration. The UE monitors PDCCH during the on-duration and during the active time and may stop monitoring outside the active time to save battery.

title: Power Headroom Reporting
text: The Power Headroom Report procedure provides the serving eNB with information about the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH transmission. A PHR is triggered when phr-Timer expires, the path loss has changed more than dl-PathlossChange, or whenever the UE has a valid UL grant after a configurable prohibit timer expires.
